name: Rafael Nadasdy
original_name: ラファエル・ナーダシュディ
source:
"Hey, there's still time for you to turn back."

One of the five nobles governing the Berezinsky domain, he represents the bloodline of Elizabeth Báthory. He lives in his own world and dislikes conflict, so he tends to stay out of others' affairs. He enjoys reading and stargazing, and spends most of his time retreating into solitude.

[Translated from [url=https://x.com/WitchB_otomate/status/2016073694792315120/]Twitter[/url]]
